task_title: install-hermes.sh must certify the PINNED harness, not any hermes on PATH
task_criteria:
1. scripts/harness/install-hermes.sh: the version row compares the measured version against PIN (default 0.19.0) and against the venv the adapter owns; a hermes resolved outside $VENV is labelled host-provided and its version mismatch FAILs or WARNs by name instead of printing PASS. A PATH stub printing 'Hermes Agent v9.9.9-not-the-pin' must not produce 'PASS version'.
2. --apply with no $VENV/bin/hermes creates the venv and installs hermes-agent==$PIN even when another hermes answers on PATH; the already-installed branch is reachable only for a venv binary whose version equals the pin.
3. tests/selftest.sh gains an arm that is RED at the pre-fix tree (PATH stub -> PASS version) and GREEN after the fix; bash tests/selftest.sh ends SELFTEST: PASS rc 0.
4. Docs claiming this gate proves the pinned install are corrected in the same commit.
5. No regression: bash -n on changed shell files, ruff clean, scripts/boardctl validate RESULT: OK.

GREEN proof: `bash tests/selftest.sh` on the fixed tree -> EXIT:0, tail `SELFTEST: PASS`, all 18 cf183 rows PASS.
  ✓ 4. Docs claiming this gate proves the pinned install are corrected in the same commit.: Same commit 5069c0a: README.md:75 now states "The 2026-11-03 host-provided `hermes` result was historical, not certification of the pinned venv install: CF-183 now FAILs host-provided binaries and compares the measured version against the pin" plus "Only `$HOME/hermes-venv/bin/hermes` passes the binary row". specs/HARNESS.md:11 Version obligation rewritten ("prints the binary's ownership and measured version; a version mismatch names both the measured value and the pin and FAILs") and specs/HARNESS.md:28-32 adds the certification paragraph (venv-only, host-provided FAILs, --apply installs pin regardless of PATH).
  ✓ 5. No regression: bash -n on changed shell files, ruff clean, scripts/boardctl validate RESULT: OK.: `bash -n scripts/harness/install-hermes.sh` -> exit 0 ("bash -n install-hermes OK"); `bash -n tests/selftest.sh` -> exit 0; `ruff check .` -> "All checks passed!" exit 0; `bash scripts/boardctl validate` -> "RESULT: OK (3 warning(s))" (warnings are pre-existing free-form CF-034 fields, not errors). Full `bash tests/selftest.sh` -> exit 0, SELFTEST: PASS.
All five criteria verified: the version row now compares the measured version to PIN and labels non-venv binaries host-provided, --apply installs the pin whenever the venv binary is missing/mismatched, selftest 31b is RED at HEAD~1 and GREEN now (SELFTEST: PASS rc 0), README/specs corrected in the same commit, and bash -n / ruff / boardctl validate all clean.
